shap_note: SHAP computed on a tree-based surrogate model over engineered features. Top features are ranked by mean absolute SHAP value.

feature_queries.name: user_stats
feature_queries.sql: SELECT e.OwnerUserId, e.timestamp, datediff('day', u.CreationDate, e.timestamp) AS user_age_days FROM eval_table e LEFT JOIN users u ON u.Id = e.OwnerUserId

feature_queries.name: post_stats
feature_queries.sql: SELECT e.OwnerUserId, e.timestamp, COUNT(p.Id) AS post_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN p.PostTypeId=1 THEN 1 END) AS question_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN p.PostTypeId=2 THEN 1 END) AS answer_count, datediff('day', MAX(p.CreationDate), e.timestamp) AS days_since_last_post, COUNT(CASE WHEN datediff('day', p.CreationDate, e.timestamp) <= 90 THEN 1 END) AS posts_90d, COUNT(CASE WHEN datediff('day', p.CreationDate, e.timestamp) BETWEEN 90 AND 180 THEN 1 END) AS posts_prev_q, COUNT(CASE WHEN datediff('day', p.CreationDate, e.timestamp) <= 365 THEN 1 END) AS posts_365d FROM eval_table e LEFT JOIN posts p ON p.OwnerUserId = e.OwnerUserId AND p.CreationDate < e.timestamp GROUP BY e.OwnerUserId, e.timestamp

feature_queries.name: comment_stats
feature_queries.sql: SELECT e.OwnerUserId, e.timestamp, COUNT(c.Id) AS comment_count, datediff('day', MAX(c.CreationDate), e.timestamp) AS days_since_last_comment, COUNT(CASE WHEN datediff('day', c.CreationDate, e.timestamp) <= 90 THEN 1 END) AS comments_90d, COUNT(CASE WHEN datediff('day', c.CreationDate, e.timestamp) BETWEEN 90 AND 180 THEN 1 END) AS comments_prev_q, COUNT(CASE WHEN datediff('day', c.CreationDate, e.timestamp) <= 365 THEN 1 END) AS comments_365d FROM eval_table e LEFT JOIN comments c ON c.UserId = e.OwnerUserId AND c.CreationDate < e.timestamp GROUP BY e.OwnerUserId, e.timestamp

feature_queries.name: badge_stats
feature_queries.sql: SELECT e.OwnerUserId, e.timestamp, COUNT(b.Id) AS badge_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN b.Class=1 THEN 1 END) AS badge_class1, COUNT(CASE WHEN b.Class=2 THEN 1 END) AS badge_class2, COUNT(CASE WHEN b.Class=3 THEN 1 END) AS badge_class3, datediff('day', MAX(b.Date), e.timestamp) AS days_since_last_badge, COUNT(CASE WHEN datediff('day', b.Date, e.timestamp) <= 90 THEN 1 END) AS badges_90d FROM eval_table e LEFT JOIN badges b ON b.UserId = e.OwnerUserId AND b.Date < e.timestamp GROUP BY e.OwnerUserId, e.timestamp

feature_queries.name: posthistory_stats
feature_queries.sql: SELECT e.OwnerUserId, e.timestamp, COUNT(h.Id) AS ph_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN h.PostHistoryTypeId IN (1,2) THEN 1 END) AS ph_create_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN h.PostHistoryTypeId IN (5,6) THEN 1 END) AS ph_edit_count, datediff('day', MAX(h.CreationDate), e.timestamp) AS days_since_last_ph, COUNT(CASE WHEN datediff('day', h.CreationDate, e.timestamp) <= 90 THEN 1 END) AS ph_90d FROM eval_table e LEFT JOIN postHistory h ON h.UserId = e.OwnerUserId AND h.CreationDate < e.timestamp GROUP BY e.OwnerUserId, e.timestamp

feature_queries.name: lagged_contrib
feature_queries.sql: SELECT e.OwnerUserId, e.timestamp, MAX(CASE WHEN t.timestamp = (SELECT MAX(t2.timestamp) FROM train_table t2 WHERE t2.OwnerUserId=e.OwnerUserId AND t2.timestamp < e.timestamp) THEN t.contribution END) AS lag1, MAX(CASE WHEN datediff('day', t.timestamp, e.timestamp) BETWEEN 90 AND 180 THEN t.contribution END) AS lag2, MAX(CASE WHEN datediff('day', t.timestamp, e.timestamp) BETWEEN 180 AND 270 THEN t.contribution END) AS lag3, MAX(CASE WHEN datediff('day', t.timestamp, e.timestamp) BETWEEN 270 AND 365 THEN t.contribution END) AS lag4, SUM(t.contribution) AS total_contrib_history, COUNT(t.timestamp) AS total_quarters_history FROM eval_table e LEFT JOIN train_table t ON t.OwnerUserId = e.OwnerUserId AND t.timestamp < e.timestamp GROUP BY e.OwnerUserId, e.timestamp

feature_queries.name: votes_on_posts
feature_queries.sql: SELECT e.OwnerUserId, e.timestamp, COUNT(v.Id) AS votes_on_posts, COUNT(CASE WHEN v.VoteTypeId=2 THEN 1 END) AS upvotes_on_posts, COUNT(CASE WHEN v.VoteTypeId=3 THEN 1 END) AS downvotes_on_posts, COUNT(CASE WHEN v.VoteTypeId=1 THEN 1 END) AS accepted_on_posts, COUNT(CASE WHEN datediff('day', v.CreationDate, e.timestamp) <= 90 THEN 1 END) AS votes_on_posts_90d FROM eval_table e LEFT JOIN posts p ON p.OwnerUserId = e.OwnerUserId AND p.CreationDate < e.timestamp LEFT JOIN votes v ON v.PostId = p.Id AND v.CreationDate < e.timestamp GROUP BY e.OwnerUserId, e.timestamp

feature_queries.name: comments_on_posts
feature_queries.sql: SELECT e.OwnerUserId, e.timestamp, COUNT(c.Id) AS comments_on_posts FROM eval_table e LEFT JOIN posts p ON p.OwnerUserId = e.OwnerUserId AND p.CreationDate < e.timestamp LEFT JOIN comments c ON c.PostId = p.Id AND c.CreationDate < e.timestamp GROUP BY e.OwnerUserId, e.timestamp
